newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says watching stock market closely--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says watching stock market closely--Jiji.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto was quoted by Jiji news agency as saying on Thursday that he would keep careful watch over stock market movements, including levels and traded volume.
"We will keep careful watch over (stock) trade movements, including price levels and volume," Hashimoto was quoted as saying at a parliamentary committee meeting.

"The tempo of the economic recovery is gradual, but continuing. Employment has improved slightly. Private demand such as corporate capital spending is firm and the economic fundamentals are not all that bad," Hashimoto was also quoted as saying.

He said Japan would try to pass this fiscal year's supplementary budget as soon as possible and get parliamentary approval for the full state budget for fiscal 1997/98, which starts in April, by the end of March.
